decisions.reason: Pre-oracle reorder population is infeasible; staged-hygiene predicates were designed from the exact scored cases, so catch efficacy is held-in and does not justify a scorer/replay framework
decisions.wins_if: After ordinary hygiene fixes land, at least 3 addition-specific mechanical escapes across at least 2 additions remain uncaught by existing checks, with public bad/fixed pairs and an independent held-out evaluation that can change the decision

decisions.reason: Existing recipe, lang-draft and lang-probe already support reuse; measured review groups show no recurring conversion class justifying another importer
decisions.wins_if: Repeated query-conversion failures remain beyond current draft/probe support, and an independent held-out comparison shows a reusable importer reduces work without reducing accuracy or provenance guarantees
